wireReadback: unavailable; local payload SHA-256 plus primary-Agent witnessed followup_task is not end-to-end wire proof
normalization: Only CRLF and CR normalize to LF for inclusion of a prior machine report. Payload SHA-256 is computed over exact UTF-8 file bytes.

protocol.initialPayload: {key}.initial.prompt.md; complete frozen contract snapshot plus only that key's original requirement; transport=spawn_agent
protocol.repairPayload: {key}.repair{1|2}.prompt.md; fixed instruction plus full prior machine report LF-normalized; transport=followup_task in same initial thread
protocol.preparedRecord: {key}.repair{1|2}.prepared.json; written before pause, records payload and report SHA-256
protocol.actualWitness: {key}.attempt{0|1|2}.transport.json; write-once asserted local payload hash, actual agent/thread identifiers, and continuity; not wire capture
protocol.limits: At most attempts 0, 1, 2; final evidence is byte-identical to last attempt; report files are write-once.
